pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal patches with smooth to slightly rounded edge gradients. The spatial area of patches decreases significantly toward the lower hindquarters compared to the larger, elongated patches on the mid-flank and neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways separating dark patches. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial or quadri-radial. Corridor thickness remains relatively uniform across the visible flank with slight expansion at the ventral transition.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane presents a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the superior neck line, characterized by small, repetitive vertical protrusions against the background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: Presence of a structural discontinuity on the dorsal ridge caused by an external biological entity (oxpecker) perched atop the mane.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of an oxpecker bird perched on the dorsal ridge near the junction of the neck and shoulder.
